name: npm
label: npm registry API
description: npm registry API via OfficialApiNode. Base https://registry.npmjs.org. Docs: https://github.com/npm/registry/blob/main/docs/REGISTRY-API.md. dist_tag_set PUT /-/package/{pkg}/dist-tags/{tag} body is a JSON string version (bodyFormat=raw). Optional npm-otp header. Auth token is config only. OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data}.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: package_get | package_versions | package_search | dist_tag_get | dist_tag_set. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'package_get'.

schema.label: pkg
schema.description: Package name for package_get, package_versions, dist_tag_*. Scoped names must encode `/` as `%2F` (e.g. @scope%2Fpkg). Example: left-pad.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Search query for package_search (GET /-/v1/search?text=). Example: react hooks.

schema.label: tag
schema.description: dist-tag name for dist_tag_set. Example: latest | next | beta.

schema.label: version
schema.description: Version to assign on dist_tag_set. Official body is a JSON string of the version (npm sends JSON.stringify(version), e.g. the bytes "1.2.3" including quotes). Example: 1.2.3 — send with quotes if the engine does not stringify.

schema.label: otp
schema.description: Optional npm one-time password for dist_tag_set when the token has auth-and-writes 2FA. Sent as header npm-otp. Example: 123456.

schema.label: size
schema.description: package_search page size (query size). Default 20, max 250. Example: 20.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: package_get, package_versions, package_search, dist_tag_get, dist_tag_set. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Token
configurationParameters.description: npm access token. Required for dist_tag_set / publish-class verbs. Public GET works if the engine still requires the secret — bind a dummy only if needed; prefer a real token.

configurationParameters.label: Pkg
configurationParameters.description: Package name for package_get, package_versions, dist_tag_*. Scoped names must encode `/` as `%2F` (e.g. @scope%2Fpkg). Example: left-pad.

configurationParameters.label: Size
configurationParameters.description: package_search page size (query size). Default 20, max 250. Example: 20.

configurationParameters.label: Text
configurationParameters.description: Search query for package_search (GET /-/v1/search?text=). Example: react hooks.

configurationParameters.label: Otp
configurationParameters.description: Optional npm one-time password for dist_tag_set when the token has auth-and-writes 2FA. Sent as header npm-otp. Example: 123456.

configurationParameters.label: Version
configurationParameters.description: Version to assign on dist_tag_set. Official body is a JSON string of the version (npm sends JSON.stringify(version), e.g. the bytes "1.2.3" including quotes). Example: 1.2.3 — send with quotes if the engine does not stringify.

configurationParameters.label: Tag
configurationParameters.description: dist-tag name for dist_tag_set. Example: latest | next | beta.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).
